title: assay verdict artifact
description:
One verdict, one lane, one commit (DESIGN-GUIDE.md 6 and 7). This file is SHIPPED AS DATA (A-029): a consumer -- ciu, a CI system, nyxloom -- validates an artifact against it without importing assay. It is HAND-WRITTEN, never generated from assay's Python model; a schema generated from the model could only ever prove the model agrees with itself. tests/test_verdict_reason_codes.py carries the drift guard that keeps its enumerations equal to src/assay/errors.py's.

THE PATTERN A LATER PACKAGE MUST FOLLOW. Claim payloads are added as ADDITIVE BRANCHES: one `if rigor == "RN" then {properties: {<payload>: ...}}` entry in $defs/claim/allOf, with the payload's own object closed by `additionalProperties: false`. The claim object itself is closed by `unevaluatedProperties: false`, so a payload is accepted ONLY inside the branch that named it -- a coverage block on an R0 claim is rejected without anyone writing a rule against it. P01b ships the R1 (coverage) branch; P04/P05 extend that payload, P08 adds R3 (canary) and P10 adds R2 (mutation), each as one more branch. Do not widen the claim to `additionalProperties: true` to make room; that deletes the guard.

ABSENT MEANS UNKNOWABLE, EMPTY MEANS KNOWN-AND-EMPTY. When no measurement happened there is no coverage block, not a zeroed one (A-025) -- a consumer that reads `pct` and ignores `outcome` must find nothing to read. When no lane ever resolved there is no `argv_declared`, not an empty one: `argv_declared: []` asserts "the lane declared no argv", which is false. The lane-resolved group below is all-present or all-absent.

schema_version.description: The VERDICT schema version. Distinct from assay.toml's own schema_version (A-065): two independently versioned contracts.

lane.description: The lane this verdict judges. Always known: a verdict is always ABOUT one named lane, even when that lane failed to load.

reason_code.description: Required on every non-PASS outcome (A-022); OMITTED, never null, on PASS (A-051). The per-outcome enumeration is closed (A-050) and is narrowed by the branches in allOf.

exit_code.description: The exit code is the verdict: a consumer checking only the exit code must never be wrong. Pinned to `outcome` by the branches in allOf, so the artifact can never disagree with the process status.

declared_rigor.description: The rigor levels the lane declared. Carried so that 'R2 was declared but rendered no judgement' stays distinguishable from 'R2 was never declared' (A-024) without the consumer holding the lane file. Part of the lane-resolved group.

argv_appended.description: Flags appended BY THE CALLER (A-036). assay never derives a flag from the diff -- that is impact-based selection, which is the caller's domain.

claims.description: One entry per declared rigor level, not a flat verdict (A-024). Empty only when no lane resolved, i.e. when the lane-resolved group is absent.

allOf.$comment: PASS: exit 0, and no reason_code at all -- a pass has no cause to name (A-051).
A run with a non-empty argv_appended sets argv_modified: true (DESIGN-GUIDE 6). An appended flag that is invisible in the verdict lets a gate PASS describe a run that skipped most of the suite.

outcome.description: A-021. Six outcomes; 2-5 are all not-a-pass and all block a merge.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 with an EXPLICIT offset. A naive timestamp is rejected: an artifact whose times cannot be placed on a timeline is not evidence.

env.description: Declared-only (A-019). Values are strings: assay never invents the spelling a process will actually see.

reason_codes.$comment: The closed per-outcome enumeration of DESIGN-GUIDE 6, shared by the verdict's `outcome` branches and the claim's `status` branches. PASS has no entry because a pass has no cause to name.

coverage.$comment: The R1 claim payload. P04 and P05 extend this object additively (files_missing_coverage, excluded, unclassified); keep it closed.
coverage.description: `considered` is srdm's fix: an empty denominator must EXPLAIN itself rather than being textually identical to a broken measurement (A-026). '3 changed file(s) under the roots, none contributing executable non-test lines (0/0)' is a different sentence from '0/0 (100.0%)'.

claim.description: The claim ENVELOPE (A-055), plus payload branches. `source` says which of the three evidence tiers produced it (A-032); `verified_by_assay` is FALSE for everything assay did not compute itself, and assay never upgrades an attestation (A-033).

allOf.$comment: A-033: assay cannot judge a review, so it never marks one verified. Laundering attested evidence as verified is worse than omitting it, because it is now on the record.

PAYLOAD BRANCH -- R1 (coverage). This is the pattern P04/P05/P08/P10 extend. Because the claim is closed by unevaluatedProperties, `coverage` is accepted ONLY where this branch names it: a coverage block on an R0/R2/R3 claim is rejected with no rule written against it.
A-025, at claim level. No percentage exists unless a measurement produced one; a zeroed block beside NO_MEASUREMENT rebuilds the exact ambiguity this project exists to remove, one layer up.
